executiveSummary:
• The tests captured a total of 269 API calls across various workflows.
• User authentication processes were consistently observed across multiple tests.
• High frequency of refresh calls may indicate inefficiencies in the workflow.
• Successful report generation workflows were executed without errors.
• Strong correlation between UI actions and API calls suggests effective integration.
• Further investigation into refresh call patterns could optimize performance.
• Overall, the system appears stable with no failed endpoints detected.
